game.core.world.fact.summary: Magic exists in Thalorien and virtually everyone has witnessed some form of magic at least once, but it is not abundant in ordinary life. Most material life, work, travel, and institutions remain recognizably medieval; magic supplements them rather than replacing ordinary labor at scale.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: User-established worldbuilding constraint; recorded and clarified by Codex (2026-08-22).
